terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; exec mise run worker
terminals.description: Agent worker (Cloud Run equivalent) on http://localhost:8080. Consumes jobs from POST /jobs, uses Redis for locks/dedup, replies to Slack.

terminals.name: webhook
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd apps/webhook && exec env PORT=3000 mise exec -- pnpm dlx tsx watch src/server.ts
terminals.description: Slack events webhook (Vercel equivalent) on http://localhost:3000. Verifies/acks Slack and dispatches jobs to the worker. Run via tsx because server.ts uses NodeNext .js->.ts imports.
